## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what users can do after this change. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Include running UI checks for changed interactions and identify skipped or unavailable checks.

## Compatibility and data implications

Describe migrations, parser/cache changes, permissions or cleanup effects when relevant. Remove this section if it does not apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated user work.
- [ ] Relevant tests and `uv run ruff check .` pass, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Evidence, unresolved diagnostics and applicable access/privacy boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Affected documentation and repository status/context maps are updated.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private source, runtime databases or backups.
